row.body: A radio is packed with the house key and a note promising someone will remain at the marked address. The battery receipt is dated after the promised check-in.
row.title: We will stay reachable

sidecar.gloss: A promised check-in outlasts the radio’s recorded battery purchase.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field team could have kept a radio at a work site; the delayed battery receipt does not prove anyone was stranded.
